title: The store refuses to open when the on-disk schema version is newer than the build's max known version
description: At open time, the migration runner reads the on-disk schema version from the bookkeeping table and compares it against the build's max known migration version. When the on-disk version is strictly greater than the build's max, the runner throws a specific error with a stable code and a message naming both versions; the process fails to start. The store makes no writes on this path.
rationale: Deploying an older build against a newer store is not a safe operation: the older build does not know about the schema shape the newer build wrote, and reads and writes against unknown columns are the shape that corrupts data silently. Refusing at open is the only place the check is cheap; once a request has been served, the damage is done.
